uxNotes: Irreversible money actions run without confirm: 'Buchen' (entry can never be edited), 'Stornieren' and 'Monat abschließen'.
Labels are bare nouns: primary 'Buchung' and menu 'Kasse / Konto' do not say 'Neue …' like other areas ('Neues Event', 'Neue Bestellung').
Sheet forms use plain SubmitButtons ('Buchen', 'Speichern') instead of <SaveBar>.
Money inputs drift: entry amount uses TypedInput kind=money, but opening balance and counted cash use Input inputMode=decimal.
Account switcher is a hand-built chip nav; account kind/sphere/invoice are NativeSelects instead of <Choice>; direction uses native radios instead of segments.
Invoice picker loads the last 100 sent invoices into a select instead of searching.
Category is free text with a datalist (same pattern contacts uses for bulk tags) – easy to create near-duplicates.
Rows only open via the first cell's link (no rowHref), unlike other DataTables where the whole row opens.
No account delete; 'Konto bearbeiten' is a ghost header button while creating an account is in the ⋯ menu.

redesign.job: Book cash in/out for one account and month, see the balance, close a finished month with a cash count.
redesign.phone: Top bar: Kassenbuch, ⋯ (Monat abschließen when due, Kasse bearbeiten, Neue Kasse, Export). Toolbar: account Segments (or a filter menu when more than 4 accounts), month ‹ März 2026 › row. Stats 2×2. Cards: description + amount, line 2 number · date · counterparty, Storno badge. Round + = Neue Buchung. Month close: callout card with the button when the month is over.
redesign.desktop: Toolbar: month ‹ › left, account switch right. Stats: Anfangsbestand · Einnahmen · Ausgaben · Endbestand. Table (whole row opens ?edit=): Buchung, Kategorie, Bereich, Betrag. Monatsabschluss section at the end (state or callout + button → sheet).
moves: primary 'Buchung' → 'Neue Buchung' (hidden when month closed / no account, unchanged)
account hand-built chip nav → <Segments> (≤ 4 accounts) or <FilterMenu>-style links in the toolbar
month ‹ › icon buttons → toolbar, size-8 targets
entries table, link only in first cell → rowHref (whole row/card opens ?edit=<id>)

Monatsabschluss inline form (counted Input decimal, note, 'Monat abschließen' without confirm) → section shows state; when the month is over: callout + 'Monat abschließen' → sheet ?new=closing with counted as TypedInput money (cash accounts), note, SaveBar 'Monat abschließen' with confirm cashbook.confirmClose + Hint
EmptyState no account + button → EmptyState with 'Neue Kasse' (unchanged)

?new=entry sheet: direction native radios → <SegmentGroup> Einnahme · Ausgabe; amount TypedInput money, date, description, category (datalist kept: suggestions without a new table), sphere NativeSelect → <Choice> (4 → segments), counterparty, invoice NativeSelect (100) → <RecordPicker> with server search of open invoices; bookHint kept; 'Buchen' SubmitButton → <SaveBar label='Buchen' always> with confirm cashbook.confirmBook

?new=account / ?edit_account sheet: name, kind NativeSelect → <Choice> segments, opening Input decimal → TypedInput money, opening_on, active checkbox; 'Speichern' → SaveBar (create: 'Kasse anlegen' always)
?edit=<entry> sheet: DetailList (unchanged) + invoice link, Belege FileList (unchanged), 'Stornieren' → sheet header action with confirm cashbook.confirmReverse + Hint
redesign.kept: uxNote 6 kept: categories stay free text with suggestions (no new table). uxNote 8: 'Kasse bearbeiten' moved into ⋯ next to 'Neue Kasse'; no delete – entries reference the account, it is switched off with 'Aktiv'. ?edit_account= kept (?edit= is the entry sheet). A negative opening balance can't be typed any more (money input); the server still accepts it.

sweep.note: Phone toolbar: month switcher and account Segments shared one row, Girokonto was cut off: month now on its own row (ListToolbar search slot), accounts below as the scrolling row; desktop unchanged (accounts right).
